titanSays.line: 📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Eulogy hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.
🗣️ Nikolai to Aruzhan, by the fire: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"
🔭 Scouts come back pale. The sky looks wrong. Not cloudy, not dark — just... bigger. Like it's closer than it should be.
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 8,4. THE HERALD — the sky, getting bigger. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,650 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
You turn to leave — behind you, The Herald stirs.
The Herald stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.

🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Big-Eyes, The Herald, The Influencer) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Herald came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 Big-Eyes, The Herald, The Influencer is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Herald: Read the omens — reposition freely. It announces everything — read the omens. It is slow: reposition freely, never trade blows standing still. (It is a tutorial — the real test comes later. Learn it here, cheap.) (Thabo lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kōwhai just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Herald is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Kōwhai has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
⚔️ Kōwhai killed the Herald alone — 1 round, 0 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
